#第 5 章　AOP：代理创建与拦截器链

#5.1 为什么需要 AOP

假设没有 AOP，你要给 100 个 Service 方法加"事务 + 日志 + 权限"，只有两种选择：

Java
// 方案一：每个方法里写一遍（重复 100 次）
public void save(Order o) {
    log.info("start");
    Transaction tx = begin();
    try {
        checkPermission();
        doSave(o);
        tx.commit();
    } catch (Exception e) { tx.rollback(); throw e; }
    finally { log.info("end"); }
}

// 方案二：AOP（写一次，垂直切下去）
@Transactional
@PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')")
@Loggable
public void save(Order o) { doSave(o); }

AOP 的本质：在不修改源码的前提下，把横切逻辑"织入"到目标方法的调用链上。

Spring AOP 的实现方式只有一个：动态代理。

Text
调用方 → 代理对象 → 拦截器链 → 目标对象
                ↑
        事务 / 日志 / 权限 / 缓存

#5.2 核心概念与类族

5.2.1 五个术语

术语含义Spring 中的类
Aspect（切面）横切逻辑的模块化@Aspect 标注的类
Joinpoint（连接点）程序执行中可以插入切面的点Spring 只支持方法执行
Pointcut（切点）匹配连接点的表达式AspectJExpressionPointcut
Advice（通知）在连接点上执行的动作MethodInterceptor / @Before / @After / @Around
Advisor（通知器）Pointcut + Advice 的组合PointcutAdvisor

一句话：Advisor 告诉 Spring "在哪切（Pointcut）+ 切了做什么（Advice）"。

5.2.2 核心类族

Text
Pointcut（去哪切）
├── AspectJExpressionPointcut     ← execution(...) 表达式解析
├── AnnotationMatchingPointcut    ← 按注解匹配
├── NameMatchMethodPointcut        ← 按方法名匹配
└── ControlFlowPointcut            ← 按调用栈匹配

Advice（做什么）
├── MethodInterceptor（最通用）
├── MethodBeforeAdvice             → MethodBeforeAdviceInterceptor
├── AfterReturningAdvice           → AfterReturningAdviceInterceptor
├── ThrowsAdvice                   → ThrowsAdviceInterceptor
└── AspectJ 注解对应的 5 种（见 5.7）

Advisor = Pointcut + Advice
├── DefaultPointcutAdvisor
├── AspectJPointcutAdvisor         ← @Aspect 解析产物
└── BeanFactoryTransactionAttributeSourceAdvisor   ← 事务

代理工厂
├── ProxyFactory                   ← 编程式
├── ProxyFactoryBean               ← XML 声明式
└── AspectJProxyFactory            ← @AspectJ 语法

#5.3 装配：@EnableAspectJAutoProxy 做了什么

Java
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Documented
@Import(AspectJAutoProxyRegistrar.class)      // ← 总开关
public @interface EnableAspectJAutoProxy {
    boolean proxyTargetClass() default false;  // 是否强制 CGLIB
    boolean exposeProxy() default false;       // 是否暴露 AopContext
}

AspectJAutoProxyRegistrar：

Java
class AspectJAutoProxyRegistrar implements ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar {
    @Override
    public void registerBeanDefinitions(AnnotationMetadata importingClassMetadata, BeanDefinitionRegistry registry) {
        // ① 注册 AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator（一个 BeanPostProcessor）
        AopConfigUtils.registerAspectJAnnotationAutoProxyCreatorIfNecessary(registry);

        // ② 读取注解属性，设置 proxyTargetClass / exposeProxy
        AnnotationAttributes enableAspectJAutoProxy = AnnotationConfigUtils.attributesFor(
                importingClassMetadata, EnableAspectJAutoProxy.class);
        if (enableAspectJAutoProxy != null) {
            if (enableAspectJAutoProxy.getBoolean("proxyTargetClass")) {
                AopConfigUtils.forceAutoProxyCreatorToUseClassProxying(registry);
            }
            if (enableAspectJAutoProxy.getBoolean("exposeProxy")) {
                AopConfigUtils.forceAutoProxyCreatorToExposeProxy(registry);
            }
        }
    }
}

关键结论：@EnableAspectJAutoProxy 的全部作用就是注册一个 BeanPostProcessor。AOP 就是在第 3 章讲的 initializeBean 第 ④ 步生效的。

#5.4 代理创建：wrapIfNecessary

AbstractAutoProxyCreator 继承链：

Text
AbstractAutoProxyCreator
  ├── AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator
  │     └── DefaultAdvisorAutoProxyCreator
  │     └── InfrastructureAdvisorAutoProxyCreator   ← 事务用
  └── AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator        ← @AspectJ 用

5.4.1 三个回调入口

Java
public abstract class AbstractAutoProxyCreator extends ProxyProcessorSupport
        implements SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor, BeanFactoryAware {

    // ① 实例化前：处理 TargetSource（可跳过后续创建）
    @Override
    public Object postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class<?> beanClass, String beanName) {
        Object cacheKey = getCacheKey(beanClass, beanName);
        if (!StringUtils.hasLength(beanName) || !this.targetSourcedBeans.contains(beanName)) {
            if (this.advisedBeans.containsKey(cacheKey)) return null;
            if (isInfrastructureClass(beanClass) || shouldSkip(beanClass, beanName)) {
                this.advisedBeans.put(cacheKey, Boolean.FALSE);
                return null;
            }
        }
        TargetSource targetSource = getCustomTargetSource(beanClass, beanName);
        if (targetSource != null) {
            if (StringUtils.hasLength(beanName)) this.targetSourcedBeans.add(beanName);
            Object[] specificInterceptors = getAdvicesAndAdvisorsForBean(beanClass, beanName, targetSource);
            Object proxy = createProxy(beanClass, beanName, specificInterceptors, targetSource);
            this.proxyTypes.put(cacheKey, proxy.getClass());
            return proxy;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ② 初始化后：正常代理入口
    @Override
    public Object postProcessAfterInitialization(@Nullable Object bean, String beanName) {
        if (bean != null) {
            Object cacheKey = getCacheKey(bean.getClass(), beanName);
            if (this.earlyProxyReferences.remove(cacheKey) != bean) {   // 已在循环依赖中代理过 → 跳过
                return wrapIfNecessary(bean, beanName, cacheKey);
            }
        }
        return bean;
    }

    // ③ 提前引用：循环依赖时提前代理
    @Override
    public Object getEarlyBeanReference(Object bean, String beanName) {
        Object cacheKey = getCacheKey(bean.getClass(), beanName);
        this.earlyProxyReferences.put(cacheKey, bean);
        return wrapIfNecessary(bean, beanName, cacheKey);
    }
}

5.4.2 wrapIfNecessary 全貌

Java
protected Object wrapIfNecessary(Object bean, String beanName, Object cacheKey) {
    // ① 已经处理过（TargetSource 场景）
    if (StringUtils.hasLength(beanName) && this.targetSourcedBeans.contains(beanName)) {
        return bean;
    }
    // ② 已判定不需要代理
    if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(this.advisedBeans.get(cacheKey))) {
        return bean;
    }
    // ③ 基础设施类 & 跳过类（如 @Aspect 本身、Advisor 本身）
    if (isInfrastructureClass(bean.getClass()) || shouldSkip(bean.getClass(), beanName)) {
        this.advisedBeans.put(cacheKey, Boolean.FALSE);
        return bean;
    }

    // ④ 找到适用的 Advisor
    Object[] specificInterceptors = getAdvicesAndAdvisorsForBean(bean.getClass(), beanName, null);
    if (specificInterceptors != DO_NOT_PROXY) {
        this.advisedBeans.put(cacheKey, Boolean.TRUE);
        // ⑤ 创建代理
        Object proxy = createProxy(bean.getClass(), beanName, specificInterceptors,
                new SingletonTargetSource(bean));
        this.proxyTypes.put(cacheKey, proxy.getClass());
        return proxy;
    }

    this.advisedBeans.put(cacheKey, Boolean.FALSE);
    return bean;
}

isInfrastructureClass 会跳过：Advice、Pointcut、Advisor、AopInfrastructureBean 及其子类——避免"给 Advisor 自己再代理一次"的死循环。

5.4.3 找 Advisor：getAdvicesAndAdvisorsForBean

Java
protected Object[] getAdvicesAndAdvisorsForBean(Class<?> beanClass, String beanName,
        @Nullable TargetSource targetSource) {
    List<Advisor> advisors = findEligibleAdvisors(beanClass, beanName);
    if (advisors.isEmpty()) return DO_NOT_PROXY;
    return advisors.toArray();
}

protected List<Advisor> findEligibleAdvisors(Class<?> beanClass, String beanName) {
    // ① 找所有候选 Advisor
    List<Advisor> candidateAdvisors = findCandidateAdvisors();
    // ② 筛选能应用到该类的
    List<Advisor> eligibleAdvisors = findAdvisorsThatCanApply(candidateAdvisors, beanClass, beanName);
    // ③ 扩展钩子 + 排序
    extendAdvisors(eligibleAdvisors);
    if (!eligibleAdvisors.isEmpty()) {
        eligibleAdvisors = sortAdvisors(eligibleAdvisors);
    }
    return eligibleAdvisors;
}

findCandidateAdvisors（AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator 重写）：

Java
protected List<Advisor> findCandidateAdvisors() {
    // ① 父类：找容器中所有 Advisor 类型的 Bean（事务就是在这里被找到的）
    List<Advisor> advisors = super.findCandidateAdvisors();
    // ② 子类：解析所有 @Aspect Bean，生成 Advisor
    if (this.aspectJAdvisorsBuilder != null) {
        advisors.addAll(this.aspectJAdvisorsBuilder.buildAspectJAdvisors());
    }
    return advisors;
}

BeanFactoryAspectJAdvisorsBuilder.buildAspectJAdvisors() 的三步：

Text
① 遍历容器中所有 Bean，用 @Aspect 注解判定（isAspect）
② 对每个 @Aspect Bean，用 ReflectiveAspectJAdvisorFactory 解析
     → 每个 @Before/@After/@Around/@AfterReturning/@AfterThrowing 生成一个 Advisor
③ 缓存到 advisorsCache（避免重复解析）

findAdvisorsThatCanApply 的核心是 AopUtils.canApply：

Java
public static boolean canApply(Advisor advisor, Class<?> targetClass, boolean hasIntroductions) {
    if (advisor instanceof IntroductionAdvisor ia) {
        return ia.getClassFilter().matches(targetClass);
    } else if (advisor instanceof PointcutAdvisor pca) {
        return canApply(pca.getPointcut(), targetClass, hasIntroductions);
    } else {
        return true;   // 没有切点 → 全部匹配
    }
}

public static boolean canApply(Pointcut pc, Class<?> targetClass, boolean hasIntroductions) {
    if (!pc.getClassFilter().matches(targetClass)) return false;   // 类级粗筛
    MethodMatcher methodMatcher = pc.getMethodMatcher();
    if (methodMatcher == MethodMatcher.TRUE) return true;
    IntroductionAwareMethodMatcher introductionAwareMethodMatcher = null;
    if (methodMatcher instanceof IntroductionAwareMethodMatcher im) introductionAwareMethodMatcher = im;

    Set<Class<?>> classes = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    if (!Proxy.isProxyClass(targetClass)) classes.add(ClassUtils.getUserClass(targetClass));
    classes.addAll(ClassUtils.getAllInterfacesForClassAsSet(targetClass));

    for (Class<?> clazz : classes) {
        Method[] methods = ReflectionUtils.getAllDeclaredMethods(clazz);
        for (Method method : methods) {
            if (introductionAwareMethodMatcher != null
                    ? introductionAwareMethodMatcher.matches(method, targetClass, hasIntroductions)
                    : methodMatcher.matches(method, targetClass)) {
                return true;      // 有一个方法匹配 → 该类需要代理
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

注意 canApply 的代价：它要遍历目标类和所有接口的全部方法做匹配。所以切点表达式写得越精确，启动越快。这也是"execution(* com.foo..*.*(..)) 会拖慢启动"的原因。

5.4.4 创建代理：createProxy

Java
protected Object createProxy(Class<?> beanClass, @Nullable String beanName,
        @Nullable Object[] specificInterceptors, TargetSource targetSource) {

    if (this.beanFactory instanceof ConfigurableListableBeanFactory clbf) {
        AutoProxyUtils.exposeTargetClass(clbf, beanName, beanClass);
    }

    ProxyFactory proxyFactory = new ProxyFactory();
    proxyFactory.copyFrom(this);                 // 继承 proxyTargetClass / exposeProxy / frozen 等配置

    // ① 决定用 JDK 还是 CGLIB
    if (!proxyFactory.isProxyTargetClass()) {
        if (shouldProxyTargetClass(beanClass, beanName)) {
            proxyFactory.setProxyTargetClass(true);
        } else {
            evaluateProxyInterfaces(beanClass, proxyFactory);
        }
    }

    // ② 添加 Advisor
    Advisor[] advisors = buildAdvisors(beanName, specificInterceptors);
    proxyFactory.addAdvisors(advisors);

    // ③ 设置目标源
    proxyFactory.setTargetSource(targetSource);
    customizeProxyFactory(proxyFactory);

    proxyFactory.setFrozen(this.freezeProxy);
    if (advisorsPreFiltered()) {
        proxyFactory.setPreFiltered(true);
    }

    // ④ 创建代理
    return proxyFactory.getProxy(getProxyClassLoader());
}

evaluateProxyInterfaces 的判断：

Java
protected void evaluateProxyInterfaces(Class<?> beanClass, ProxyFactory proxyFactory) {
    Class<?>[] targetInterfaces = ClassUtils.getAllInterfacesForClass(beanClass, getProxyClassLoader());
    boolean hasReasonableProxyInterface = false;
    for (Class<?> ifc : targetInterfaces) {
        if (!isConfigurationCallbackInterface(ifc) && !isInternalLanguageInterface(ifc) && ifc.getMethods().length > 0) {
            hasReasonableProxyInterface = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (hasReasonableProxyInterface) {
        for (Class<?> ifc : targetInterfaces) proxyFactory.addInterface(ifc);
    } else {
        proxyFactory.setProxyTargetClass(true);   // 没有合适接口 → 强制 CGLIB
    }
}

#5.5 代理实现：JDK 还是 CGLIB

5.5.1 选择逻辑

Java
// DefaultAopProxyFactory
public AopProxy createAopProxy(AdvisedSupport config) throws AopConfigException {
    if (!config.isOptimize() && !config.isProxyTargetClass() && !hasNoUserSuppliedProxyInterfaces(config)) {
        return new JdkDynamicAopProxy(config);
    }
    Class<?> targetClass = config.getTargetClass();
    if (targetClass == null) throw new AopConfigException("TargetSource cannot determine target class...");
    if (targetClass.isInterface() || Proxy.isProxyClass(targetClass)) {
        return new JdkDynamicAopProxy(config);
    }
    return new ObjenesisCglibAopProxy(config);
}
条件选择
proxyTargetClass = trueCGLIB
目标类没有实现任何用户接口CGLIB
目标类本身就是接口 / 已是代理JDK
其余JDK

Spring Boot 2.x 起 spring.aop.proxy-target-class 默认 true（默认 CGLIB），因为 CGLIB 能代理类、能注入到具体类型、不需要接口。

5.5.2 JDK 动态代理：JdkDynamicAopProxy

Java
final class JdkDynamicAopProxy implements AopProxy, InvocationHandler, Serializable {

    private final AdvisedSupport advised;

    @Override
    public Object getProxy(@Nullable ClassLoader classLoader) {
        return Proxy.newProxyInstance(classLoader, this.proxiedInterfaces, this);
    }

    @Override
    public Object invoke(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) throws Throwable {
        Object oldProxy = null;
        boolean setProxyContext = false;
        TargetSource targetSource = this.advised.targetSource;
        Object target = null;

        try {
            // ① 处理 equals / hashCode（不代理）
            if (!this.equalsDefined && AopUtils.isEqualsMethod(method)) return equals(args[0]);
            if (!this.hashCodeDefined && AopUtils.isHashCodeMethod(method)) return hashCode();

            // ② 处理 DecoratingProxy
            if (method.getDeclaringClass() == DecoratingProxy.class) {
                return AopProxyUtils.ultimateTargetClass(this.advised);
            }

            // ③ 处理 Advised 接口方法（getTargetSource / getAdvisors 等）
            if (!this.advised.opaque && method.getDeclaringClass().isInterface()
                    && method.getDeclaringClass().isAssignableFrom(Advised.class)) {
                return AopUtils.invokeJoinpointUsingReflection(this.advised, method, args);
            }

            Object retVal;

            // ④ 是否暴露代理（AopContext.currentProxy()）
            if (this.advised.exposeProxy) {
                oldProxy = AopContext.setCurrentProxy(proxy);
                setProxyContext = true;
            }

            // ⑤ 获取目标对象
            target = targetSource.getTarget();
            Class<?> targetClass = (target != null ? target.getClass() : null);

            // ⑥ 获取拦截器链
            List<Object> chain = this.advised.getInterceptorsAndDynamicInterceptionAdvice(method, targetClass);

            if (chain.isEmpty()) {
                // ⑦ 无增强 → 直接反射调用
                Object[] argsToUse = AopProxyUtils.adaptArgumentsIfNecessary(method, args);
                retVal = AopUtils.invokeJoinpointUsingReflection(target, method, argsToUse);
            } else {
                // ⑧ 有增强 → 构造 ReflectiveMethodInvocation，走责任链
                MethodInvocation invocation = new ReflectiveMethodInvocation(
                        proxy, target, method, args, targetClass, chain);
                retVal = invocation.proceed();
            }

            // ⑨ 处理返回值类型
            Class<?> returnType = method.getReturnType();
            if (retVal != null && retVal == target && returnType != Object.class
                    && returnType.isInstance(proxy) && !RawTargetAccess.class.isAssignableFrom(method.getDeclaringClass())) {
                retVal = proxy;      // 返回 this 时转成代理
            } else if (retVal == null && returnType != Void.TYPE && returnType.isPrimitive()) {
                throw new AopInvocationException("Null return value from advice does not match primitive return type for: " + method);
            }
            return retVal;
        } finally {
            if (target != null && !targetSource.isStatic()) targetSource.releaseTarget(target);
            if (setProxyContext) AopContext.setCurrentProxy(oldProxy);
        }
    }
}

三个细节：

  1. equals / hashCode 不走代理——否则 a.equals(b) 会触发拦截器链，可能死循环。
  2. 若方法返回 this（return this;），会转成代理对象返回，保证 this 语义。
  3. AopContext.setCurrentProxy 只在 exposeProxy = true 时开启，用于"自调用也走代理"。

5.5.3 CGLIB 代理：CglibAopProxy

Java
class CglibAopProxy implements AopProxy, Serializable {

    @Override
    public Object getProxy(@Nullable ClassLoader classLoader) {
        Class<?> rootClass = this.advised.getTargetClass();
        Class<?> proxySuperClass = rootClass;

        // 若目标类本身已是 CGLIB 代理，取其父类
        if (ClassUtils.isCglibProxyClass(rootClass)) {
            proxySuperClass = rootClass.getSuperclass();
            Class<?>[] additionalInterfaces = rootClass.getInterfaces();
            for (Class<?> additionalInterface : additionalInterfaces) {
                this.advised.addInterface(additionalInterface);
            }
        }

        validateClassIfNecessary(proxySuperClass, classLoader);

        Enhancer enhancer = createEnhancer();
        enhancer.setSuperclass(proxySuperClass);
        enhancer.setInterfaces(AopProxyUtils.completeProxiedInterfaces(this.advised));
        enhancer.setNamingPolicy(SpringNamingPolicy.INSTANCE);
        enhancer.setAttemptLoad(true);

        Callback[] callbacks = getCallbacks(rootClass);
        Class<?>[] types = new Class<?>[callbacks.length];
        for (int x = 0; x < types.length; x++) types[x] = callbacks[x].getClass();
        enhancer.setCallbackFilter(new ProxyCallbackFilter(this.advised.getConfigurationOnlyCopy(), ...));
        enhancer.setCallbackTypes(types);
        enhancer.setCallbacks(callbacks);

        return createProxyClassAndInstance(enhancer, callbacks);
    }
}

CglibAopProxy.DynamicAdvisedInterceptor.intercept 的逻辑与 JdkDynamicAopProxy.invoke 几乎一致：拿链 → 创建 CglibMethodInvocation → proceed()。

CGLIB 的两个限制：

限制原因
不能代理 final 类 / final 方法需要继承与重写
不能代理 private 方法子类无法覆盖
static 方法不生效静态方法绑定在类上

Spring 6 的 ObjenesisCglibAopProxy：不调用目标类的构造器，直接 objenesis.newInstance() 创建代理实例，避免"构造器副作用执行两次"的问题。

#5.6 拦截器链：责任链的核心

5.6.1 AdvisorChainFactory

Java
// DefaultAdvisorChainFactory
public List<Object> getInterceptorsAndDynamicInterceptionAdvice(Advised config, Method method, @Nullable Class<?> targetClass) {
    List<Object> interceptorList = new ArrayList<>(config.getAdvisors().length);
    Class<?> actualClass = (targetClass != null ? targetClass : method.getDeclaringClass());
    boolean hasIntroductions = hasMatchingIntroductions(config, actualClass);

    AdvisorAdapterRegistry registry = GlobalAdvisorAdapterRegistry.getInstance();

    for (Advisor advisor : config.getAdvisors()) {
        if (advisor instanceof PointcutAdvisor pointcutAdvisor) {
            // ① 类级匹配 + 方法级匹配
            if (config.isPreFiltered() || pointcutAdvisor.getPointcut().getClassFilter().matches(actualClass)) {
                MethodMatcher mm = pointcutAdvisor.getPointcut().getMethodMatcher();
                boolean match;
                if (mm instanceof IntroductionAwareMethodMatcher iamm) {
                    match = iamm.matches(method, actualClass, hasIntroductions);
                } else {
                    match = mm.matches(method, actualClass);
                }
                if (match) {
                    // ② Advisor → MethodInterceptor[]
                    MethodInterceptor[] interceptors = registry.getInterceptors(advisor);
                    if (mm.isRuntime()) {
                        // ③ 运行时匹配（如 args() / @annotation()）→ 包一层动态匹配
                        for (MethodInterceptor interceptor : interceptors) {
                            interceptorList.add(new InterceptorAndDynamicMethodMatcher(interceptor, mm));
                        }
                    } else {
                        interceptorList.addAll(Arrays.asList(interceptors));
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (advisor instanceof IntroductionAdvisor ia) { ... }
        else {
            Interceptor[] interceptors = registry.getInterceptors(advisor);
            interceptorList.addAll(Arrays.asList(interceptors));
        }
    }
    return interceptorList;
}

5.6.2 AdvisorAdapter：把 Advice 转成 Interceptor

Java
// DefaultAdvisorAdapterRegistry 注册了三个适配器
public DefaultAdvisorAdapterRegistry() {
    registerAdvisorAdapter(new MethodBeforeAdviceAdapter());
    registerAdvisorAdapter(new AfterReturningAdviceAdapter());
    registerAdvisorAdapter(new ThrowsAdviceAdapter());
}
Advice 类型适配器生成的 Interceptor
MethodBeforeAdviceMethodBeforeAdviceAdapterMethodBeforeAdviceInterceptor
AfterReturningAdviceAfterReturningAdviceAdapterAfterReturningAdviceInterceptor
ThrowsAdviceThrowsAdviceAdapterThrowsAdviceInterceptor
MethodInterceptor无需适配自身

这就是适配器模式在 AOP 里的应用：让不同形态的"通知"统一成 MethodInterceptor 接口。

5.6.3 ReflectiveMethodInvocation：递归责任链

Java
public class ReflectiveMethodInvocation implements ProxyMethodInvocation {

    protected final Object proxy;
    protected final Object target;
    protected final Method method;
    protected Object[] arguments;
    private final Class<?> targetClass;
    private final List<?> interceptorsAndDynamicMethodMatchers;
    private int currentInterceptorIndex = -1;         // ← 链的游标

    public Object proceed() throws Throwable {
        // ① 链尾 → 调用目标方法
        if (this.currentInterceptorIndex == this.interceptorsAndDynamicMethodMatchers.size() - 1) {
            return invokeJoinpoint();
        }

        // ② 取下一个拦截器
        Object interceptorOrInterceptionAdvice =
                this.interceptorsAndDynamicMethodMatchers.get(++this.currentInterceptorIndex);

        // ③ 动态匹配（运行时切点）
        if (interceptorOrInterceptionAdvice instanceof InterceptorAndDynamicMethodMatcher dm) {
            Class<?> targetClass = (this.targetClass != null ? this.targetClass : this.method.getDeclaringClass());
            if (dm.methodMatcher.matches(this.method, targetClass, this.arguments)) {
                return dm.interceptor.invoke(this);
            } else {
                return proceed();       // 不匹配 → 跳过，继续下一个
            }
        } else {
            // ④ 普通拦截器 → 调用它的 invoke，它会再回调 proceed()
            return ((MethodInterceptor) interceptorOrInterceptionAdvice).invoke(this);
        }
    }

    protected Object invokeJoinpoint() throws Throwable {
        return AopUtils.invokeJoinpointUsingReflection(this.target, this.method, this.arguments);
    }
}

递归的精髓：每个拦截器内部调用 invocation.proceed()，游标 currentInterceptorIndex 递增，直到链尾执行目标方法。所以拦截器是"嵌套"执行的，不是"顺序"执行的：

Text
interceptor1.invoke()
  ├─ 前置逻辑
  ├─ proceed()
  │    ├─ interceptor2.invoke()
  │    │    ├─ 前置逻辑
  │    │    ├─ proceed() → 目标方法
  │    │    └─ 后置逻辑
  │    └─ ...
  └─ 后置逻辑

#5.7 通知类型与执行顺序

5.7.1 五种注解

注解对应 Advice对应 Interceptor执行时机
@BeforeAspectJMethodBeforeAdviceMethodBeforeAdviceInterceptor目标方法前
@AfterReturningAspectJAfterReturningAdviceAfterReturningAdviceInterceptor目标方法正常返回后
@AfterThrowingAspectJAfterThrowingAdvice自身目标方法抛异常后
@AfterAspectJAfterAdvice自身finally 语义
@AroundAspectJAroundAdvice自身包住整个调用

5.7.2 正常流程顺序

Java
@Aspect
@Component
public class LogAspect {
    @Around("execution(* com.foo.service.*.*(..))")
    public Object around(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp) throws Throwable {
        System.out.println("@Around 前");
        Object result = pjp.proceed();
        System.out.println("@Around 后");
        return result;
    }
    @Before("execution(* com.foo.service.*.*(..))")
    public void before() { System.out.println("@Before"); }
    @AfterReturning("execution(* com.foo.service.*.*(..))")
    public void afterReturning() { System.out.println("@AfterReturning"); }
    @After("execution(* com.foo.service.*.*(..))")
    public void after() { System.out.println("@After"); }
}

输出顺序：

Text
@Around 前
@Before
（目标方法执行）
@AfterReturning
@After
@Around 后

5.7.3 异常流程

Text
@Around 前
@Before
（目标方法抛异常）
@AfterThrowing
@After
（异常继续向上抛）

关键：@Around 内如果 catch 了异常并正常返回，@AfterThrowing 不会执行；如果 throw，则继续传播。

5.7.4 为什么 @Around 只执行一次？

因为 @Around 对应的 AspectJAroundAdvice 本身就是一个 MethodInterceptor，它在链中只有一个位置。它内部调用 proceed() 恰好一次，所以包围逻辑只执行一次。若在 @Around 里调用两次 proceed()，目标方法就会执行两次——这是"重试"的常见写法，也是"重复执行"的常见 bug。

#5.8 切点表达式

表达式含义
execution(* com.foo.service.*.*(..))方法签名匹配（最常用）
within(com.foo.service..*)包/类级别匹配
this(com.foo.FooService)代理对象是 FooService 类型
target(com.foo.FooService)目标对象是 FooService 类型
args(java.lang.String)参数类型匹配
@annotation(com.foo.Loggable)方法上有某注解
@within(com.foo.Loggable)类上有某注解
@target(com.foo.Loggable)目标类有某注解
bean(orderService)Bean 名称匹配（Spring 特有）

@annotation vs @within vs @target 的区别：

表达式匹配位置运行时开销
@annotation方法上的注解方法级，需运行时检查
@within类上的注解（不包含继承）类级，编译期可确定
@target目标对象的类上有注解运行时，性能最差

#5.9 多切面排序

Java
@Aspect
@Order(1)      // 数字越小，优先级越高（越靠外层）
@Component
public class TxAspect { }

@Aspect
@Order(2)
@Component
public class LogAspect { }

执行顺序：

Text
TxAspect 前 → LogAspect 前 → 目标 → LogAspect 后 → TxAspect 后

排序规则：AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.sort(advisors)，读 @Order 或 Ordered 接口。order 越小越靠前（越外层）。

#5.10 五个经典坑（源码级原因）

坑源码原因解法
同类方法自调用失效调用的是 this，不经过代理拆类 / 注入自身 / AopContext.currentProxy()
private / final 方法不生效JDK 只能代理接口 public 方法；CGLIB 不能重写 final/private改 public / 非 final
@Transactional 与 @Async 同时用两个独立的 BeanPostProcessor 各自代理，可能嵌套拆分方法
循环依赖 + AOP 报错提前代理后类型不匹配@Lazy
代理对象强转原类型失败JDK 代理只实现接口，不是原类用接口注入，或强制 CGLIB

#5.11 编程式 AOP（理解原理的最好方式）

Java
public class ManualAopDemo {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // 目标对象
        UserService target = new UserServiceImpl();

        // 通知
        MethodInterceptor around = invocation -> {
            System.out.println("before");
            Object result = invocation.proceed();
            System.out.println("after");
            return result;
        };

        // 切点 + 通知 = Advisor
        AspectJExpressionPointcut pointcut = new AspectJExpressionPointcut();
        pointcut.setExpression("execution(* com.foo.service.*.*(..))");
        DefaultPointcutAdvisor advisor = new DefaultPointcutAdvisor(pointcut, around);

        // 代理工厂
        ProxyFactory factory = new ProxyFactory(target);
        factory.addAdvisor(advisor);
        factory.setProxyTargetClass(true);          // 强制 CGLIB

        UserService proxy = (UserService) factory.getProxy();
        proxy.save();
    }
}

这段代码就是 @EnableAspectJAutoProxy 背后做的全部事情——只不过 Spring 把"找切点、建代理、放进容器"自动化了。

#第 6 章　事务：AOP 的最佳实践案例

事务是 AOP 最成功的应用：一个 @Transactional 注解，背后是一个 Advisor + 一条拦截器链 + 一套事务状态机。读懂事务，等于把 AOP 又复习了一遍。

#6.1 事务抽象：五个核心接口

Text
PlatformTransactionManager（事务管理器）
  ├── getTransaction(TransactionDefinition) → TransactionStatus   开启/加入事务
  ├── commit(TransactionStatus)                                   提交
  └── rollback(TransactionStatus)                                 回滚

TransactionDefinition（事务定义：属性）
  ├── getPropagationBehavior()   传播行为
  ├── getIsolationLevel()        隔离级别
  ├── getTimeout()               超时
  ├── isReadOnly()               只读
  └── getName()                  名称（用于日志/监控）

TransactionStatus（事务状态）
  ├── isNewTransaction()         是否新事务
  ├── hasSavepoint()             是否有保存点
  ├── setRollbackOnly()          标记回滚
  ├── isRollbackOnly()           是否已标记回滚
  └── isCompleted()              是否已完成

实现类：

接口实现说明
PlatformTransactionManagerDataSourceTransactionManager单数据源 JDBC
JtaTransactionManager分布式事务
JpaTransactionManagerJPA
HibernateTransactionManagerHibernate
ReactiveTransactionManager响应式
TransactionDefinitionDefaultTransactionDefinition默认 REQUIRED
RuleBasedTransactionAttribute支持 rollbackFor 规则
TransactionStatusDefaultTransactionStatus默认实现

隔离级别（对应 JDBC）：

常量值说明
ISOLATION_DEFAULT-1用数据库默认
ISOLATION_READ_UNCOMMITTED1读未提交
ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED2读已提交
ISOLATION_REPEATABLE_READ4可重复读
ISOLATION_SERIALIZABLE8串行化

#6.2 装配链路：@EnableTransactionManagement 做了什么

Java
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Documented
@Import(TransactionManagementConfigurationSelector.class)
public @interface EnableTransactionManagement {
    boolean proxyTargetClass() default false;
    AdviceMode mode() default AdviceMode.PROXY;      // PROXY / ASPECTJ
    int order() default Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE;
}

TransactionManagementConfigurationSelector：

Java
public class TransactionManagementConfigurationSelector extends AdviceModeImportSelector<EnableTransactionManagement> {
    @Override
    protected String[] selectImports(AdviceMode adviceMode) {
        switch (adviceMode) {
            case PROXY:
                return new String[] {
                        AutoProxyRegistrar.class.getName(),                          // ① 注册代理创建器
                        ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration.class.getName() };   // ② 注册事务三大件
            case ASPECTJ:
                return new String[] {
                        TransactionManagementConfigUtils.TRANSACTION_ASPECT_CONFIGURATION_CLASS_NAME };
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }
}

AutoProxyRegistrar

Java
public class AutoProxyRegistrar implements ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar {
    @Override
    public void registerBeanDefinitions(AnnotationMetadata importingClassMetadata, BeanDefinitionRegistry registry) {
        boolean candidateFound = false;
        Set<String> annTypes = importingClassMetadata.getAnnotationTypes();
        for (String annType : annTypes) {
            // 读取 @EnableTransactionManagement 的属性
            if (TransactionManagementConfigUtils.TRANSACTIONAL_EVENT_LISTENER_FACTORY_BEAN_NAME.equals(annType)) { ... }
        }
        // 注册 InfrastructureAdvisorAutoProxyCreator
        AopConfigUtils.registerAutoProxyCreatorIfNecessary(registry);
        // 设置 proxyTargetClass
    }
}

关键：它注册的是 InfrastructureAdvisorAutoProxyCreator，而不是 AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator。

代理创建器识别的 Advisor用途
InfrastructureAdvisorAutoProxyCreator只识别 ROLE_INFRASTRUCTURE 的 Advisor事务、缓存、异步
AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator所有 Advisor + @Aspect用户自定义 AOP

这意味着：即使你没写 @EnableAspectJAutoProxy，只要用了 @EnableTransactionManagement，容器里也会有代理创建器——因为它们是两个独立的 BeanPostProcessor。

ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration

Java
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
@Role(BeanDefinition.ROLE_INFRASTRUCTURE)
public class ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration extends AbstractTransactionManagementConfiguration {

    @Bean(name = TransactionManagementConfigUtils.TRANSACTION_ADVISOR_BEAN_NAME)
    @Role(BeanDefinition.ROLE_INFRASTRUCTURE)
    public BeanFactoryTransactionAttributeSourceAdvisor transactionAdvisor(
            TransactionAttributeSource transactionAttributeSource,
            TransactionInterceptor transactionInterceptor) {
        BeanFactoryTransactionAttributeSourceAdvisor advisor = new BeanFactoryTransactionAttributeSourceAdvisor();
        advisor.setTransactionAttributeSource(transactionAttributeSource);
        advisor.setAdvice(transactionInterceptor);
        if (this.enableTx != null) {
            advisor.setOrder(this.enableTx.<Integer>getNumber("order"));
        }
        return advisor;
    }

    @Bean
    @Role(BeanDefinition.ROLE_INFRASTRUCTURE)
    public TransactionAttributeSource transactionAttributeSource() {
        return new AnnotationTransactionAttributeSource();
    }

    @Bean
    @Role(BeanDefinition.ROLE_INFRASTRUCTURE)
    public TransactionInterceptor transactionInterceptor(TransactionAttributeSource transactionAttributeSource) {
        TransactionInterceptor interceptor = new TransactionInterceptor();
        interceptor.setTransactionAttributeSource(transactionAttributeSource);
        if (this.txManager != null) {
            interceptor.setTransactionManager(this.txManager);
        }
        return interceptor;
    }
}

三个 Bean 就是事务的全部：

Bean角色
BeanFactoryTransactionAttributeSourceAdvisorAdvisor：切点是"有 @Transactional 的方法"
AnnotationTransactionAttributeSource属性解析：读 @Transactional 的隔离级别/传播行为/异常规则
TransactionInterceptorAdvice：真正开启、提交、回滚事务

切点是怎么定义的？

Java
public class TransactionAttributeSourcePointcut extends StaticMethodMatcherPointcut implements Serializable {
    @Override
    public boolean matches(Method method, Class<?> targetClass) {
        TransactionAttributeSource tas = getTransactionAttributeSource();
        return (tas == null || tas.getTransactionAttribute(method, targetClass) != null);
    }
}

"方法上有 @Transactional"就是切点——一个"动态"的切点：凡是能解析出事务属性的方法，就匹配。

#6.3 执行流程：invokeWithinTransaction

Java
public class TransactionInterceptor extends TransactionAspectSupport implements MethodInterceptor, Serializable {

    @Override
    public Object invoke(MethodInvocation invocation) throws Throwable {
        Class<?> targetClass = (invocation.getThis() != null ? AopUtils.getTargetClass(invocation.getThis()) : null);
        return invokeWithinTransaction(invocation.getMethod(), targetClass, new CoroutinesInvocationCallback() {
            @Override
            public Object proceedWithInvocation() throws Throwable {
                return invocation.proceed();
            }
            @Override
            public Object getTarget() { return invocation.getThis(); }
            @Override
            public Object[] getArguments() { return invocation.getArguments(); }
        });
    }
}

TransactionAspectSupport.invokeWithinTransaction：

Java
protected Object invokeWithinTransaction(Method method, @Nullable Class<?> targetClass,
        final InvocationCallback invocation) throws Throwable {

    // ① 获取事务属性（读 @Transactional）
    TransactionAttributeSource tas = getTransactionAttributeSource();
    final TransactionAttribute txAttr = (tas != null ? tas.getTransactionAttribute(method, targetClass) : null);

    // ② 确定事务管理器
    final TransactionManager tm = determineTransactionManager(txAttr);

    // ③ 响应式事务分支（略）
    if (this.reactiveAdapterRegistry != null && tm instanceof ReactiveTransactionManager rtm) { ... }

    PlatformTransactionManager ptm = asPlatformTransactionManager(tm);
    final String joinpointIdentification = methodIdentification(method, targetClass, txAttr);

    if (txAttr == null || !(ptm instanceof CallbackPreferringPlatformTransactionManager cpptm)) {
        // ④ 开启事务（或加入已有事务）
        TransactionInfo txInfo = createTransactionIfNecessary(ptm, txAttr, joinpointIdentification);
        Object retVal;
        try {
            // ⑤ 执行目标方法（会进入内层拦截器）
            retVal = invocation.proceedWithInvocation();
        } catch (Throwable ex) {
            // ⑥ 异常 → 判断是否回滚
            completeTransactionAfterThrowing(txInfo, ex);
            throw ex;
        } finally {
            // ⑦ 清理线程绑定
            cleanupTransactionInfo(txInfo);
        }

        if (retVal != null && txAttr != null) {
            TransactionStatus status = txInfo.getTransactionStatus();
            if (status != null) { ... }
        }

        // ⑧ 正常返回 → 提交
        commitTransactionAfterReturning(txInfo);
        return retVal;
    } else {
        // 编程式回调风格（CallbackPreferringPlatformTransactionManager）
    }
}

6.3.1 createTransactionIfNecessary

Java
protected TransactionInfo createTransactionIfNecessary(PlatformTransactionManager tm,
        TransactionAttribute txAttr, final String joinpointIdentification) {

    // ① 没有名字就用方法签名（便于日志定位）
    if (txAttr != null && txAttr.getName() == null) {
        txAttr = new DelegatingTransactionAttribute(txAttr) {
            @Override
            public String getName() { return joinpointIdentification; }
        };
    }

    TransactionStatus status = null;
    if (txAttr != null) {
        if (tm != null) {
            status = tm.getTransaction(txAttr);        // ← 核心
        } else {
            logger.debug("Skipping transaction...");
        }
    }
    // ② 绑定到 ThreadLocal（TransactionInfo）
    return prepareTransactionInfo(tm, txAttr, joinpointIdentification, status);
}

6.3.2 getTransaction：事务状态机

Java
public final TransactionStatus getTransaction(@Nullable TransactionDefinition definition) {
    // ① 获取"事务对象"（DataSourceTransactionManager 里就是 ConnectionHolder）
    Object transaction = doGetTransaction();

    if (definition == null) definition = new DefaultTransactionDefinition();

    // ② 已存在事务？
    if (isExistingTransaction(transaction)) {
        return handleExistingTransaction(definition, transaction, debugEnabled);   // 传播行为分支
    }

    // ③ 超时检查
    if (definition.getTimeout() < TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT) {
        throw new InvalidTimeoutException("Invalid transaction timeout", definition.getTimeout());
    }

    // ④ 无事务时的传播行为检查
    if (definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_MANDATORY) {
        throw new IllegalTransactionStateException(
                "No existing transaction found for transaction marked with propagation 'mandatory'");
    } else if (definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED
            || definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW
            || definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_NESTED) {
        // ⑤ 新建事务
        SuspendedResourcesHolder suspendedResources = suspend(null);
        try {
            return startTransaction(definition, transaction, debugEnabled, suspendedResources);
        } catch (RuntimeException | Error ex) {
            resume(null, suspendedResources);
            throw ex;
        }
    } else {
        // ⑥ SUPPORTS / NOT_SUPPORTED / NEVER → 以非事务方式执行
        boolean newSynchronization = (getTransactionSynchronization() == SYNCHRONIZATION_ALWAYS);
        return prepareTransactionStatus(definition, transaction, true, newSynchronization, debugEnabled, null);
    }
}

DataSourceTransactionManager.doBegin（真正开启事务）：

Java
protected void doBegin(Object transaction, TransactionDefinition definition) {
    DataSourceTransactionObject txObject = (DataSourceTransactionObject) transaction;
    Connection con = null;
    try {
        // ① 没有连接就新建
        if (!txObject.hasConnectionHolder() || txObject.getConnectionHolder().isSynchronizedWithTransaction()) {
            Connection newCon = obtainDataSource().getConnection();
            txObject.setConnectionHolder(new ConnectionHolder(newCon), true);
        }

        txObject.getConnectionHolder().setSynchronizedWithTransaction(true);
        con = txObject.getConnectionHolder().getConnection();

        // ② 设置隔离级别
        Integer previousIsolationLevel = DataSourceUtils.prepareConnectionForTransaction(con, definition);
        txObject.setPreviousIsolationLevel(previousIsolationLevel);
        txObject.setReadOnly(definition.isReadOnly());

        // ③ 关闭自动提交
        if (con.getAutoCommit()) {
            txObject.setMustRestoreAutoCommit(true);
            con.setAutoCommit(false);
        }

        // ④ 钩子（如设置事务隔离、只读）
        prepareTransactionalConnection(con, definition);
        txObject.getConnectionHolder().setTransactionActive(true);

        int timeout = determineTimeout(definition);
        if (timeout != TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT) {
            txObject.getConnectionHolder().setTimeoutInSeconds(timeout);
        }

        // ⑤ 绑定到 ThreadLocal（key 是 DataSource）
        if (txObject.isNewConnectionHolder()) {
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.bindResource(obtainDataSource(), txObject.getConnectionHolder());
        }
    } catch (Throwable ex) { ... }
}

ThreadLocal 绑定是关键：同一个线程内，后续所有 DataSourceUtils.getConnection(dataSource) 都会拿到同一个连接，这就是"事务传播"的物理基础。

#6.4 七种传播行为（源码分支 + 语义）

handleExistingTransaction 是传播行为的"总开关"：

Java
private TransactionStatus handleExistingTransaction(TransactionDefinition definition, Object transaction, boolean debugEnabled) {
    // ① NEVER：有事务就报错
    if (definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_NEVER) {
        throw new IllegalTransactionStateException(
                "Existing transaction found for transaction marked with propagation 'never'");
    }

    // ② NOT_SUPPORTED：挂起当前事务，以非事务方式执行
    if (definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_NOT_SUPPORTED) {
        Object suspendedResources = suspend(transaction);
        boolean newSynchronization = (getTransactionSynchronization() == SYNCHRONIZATION_ALWAYS);
        return prepareTransactionStatus(definition, null, false, newSynchronization, debugEnabled, suspendedResources);
    }

    // ③ REQUIRES_NEW：挂起当前事务，新建独立事务
    if (definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW) {
        SuspendedResourcesHolder suspendedResources = suspend(transaction);
        try {
            return startTransaction(definition, transaction, debugEnabled, suspendedResources);
        } catch (RuntimeException | Error beginEx) {
            resumeAfterBeginException(transaction, suspendedResources, beginEx);
            throw beginEx;
        }
    }

    // ④ NESTED：创建保存点（或新建事务，取决于配置）
    if (definition.getPropagationBehavior() == TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_NESTED) {
        if (!isNestedTransactionAllowed()) {
            throw new NestedTransactionNotSupportedException(
                    "Transaction manager does not allow nested transactions by default - " +
                    "specify 'nestedTransactionAllowed' property with value 'true'");
        }
        if (useSavepointForNestedTransaction()) {
            DefaultTransactionStatus status = prepareTransactionStatus(
                    definition, transaction, false, false, debugEnabled, null);
            status.createAndHoldSavepoint();     // ← JDBC 用 savepoint
            return status;
        } else {
            return startTransaction(definition, transaction, debugEnabled, null);
        }
    }

    // ⑤ MANDATORY / REQUIRED / SUPPORTS：加入当前事务
    return prepareTransactionStatus(definition, transaction, false, false, debugEnabled, null);
}
传播行为当前无事务当前有事务源码分支
REQUIRED（默认）新建加入最后一行
REQUIRES_NEW新建挂起当前，新建分支 ③
NESTED新建保存点分支 ④
SUPPORTS非事务执行加入最后一行
NOT_SUPPORTED非事务执行挂起当前，非事务分支 ②
MANDATORY抛异常加入getTransaction 第 ④ 步
NEVER非事务执行抛异常分支 ①

NESTED vs REQUIRES_NEW 的本质区别：

对比NESTEDREQUIRES_NEW
实现Savepoint新连接 + 新事务
回滚范围只回滚内层，外层可继续内外完全独立
外层回滚内层一起回滚内层不受影响
连接数1 个2 个（可能死锁）

#6.5 提交与回滚

提交：processCommit

Java
private void processCommit(DefaultTransactionStatus status) throws TransactionException {
    try {
        boolean beforeCompletionInvoked = false;
        try {
            boolean unexpectedRollback = false;
            prepareForCommit(status);
            triggerBeforeCommit(status);                 // ① 事务同步器 beforeCommit
            triggerBeforeCompletion(status);             // ② 事务同步器 beforeCompletion
            beforeCompletionInvoked = true;

            if (status.hasSavepoint()) {
                // ③ 嵌套事务：只释放保存点，不提交
                status.releaseHeldSavepoint();
            } else if (status.isNewTransaction()) {
                // ④ 新事务：真正提交
                unexpectedRollback = status.isGlobalRollbackOnly();
                doCommit(status);
            } else if (isFailEarlyOnGlobalRollbackOnly()) {
                unexpectedRollback = status.isGlobalRollbackOnly();
            }

            if (unexpectedRollback) {
                throw new UnexpectedRollbackException(
                        "Transaction silently rolled back because it has been marked as rollback-only");
            }
        } catch (UnexpectedRollbackException ex) {
            triggerAfterCompletion(status, TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_ROLLED_BACK);
            throw ex;
        } catch (TransactionException ex) {
            if (isRollbackOnCommitFailure()) doRollbackOnCommitException(status, ex);
            else triggerAfterCompletion(status, TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_UNKNOWN);
            throw ex;
        } catch (RuntimeException | Error ex) { ... }

        try {
            triggerAfterCommit(status);                  // ⑤ 提交后回调
        } finally {
            triggerAfterCompletion(status, TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_COMMITTED);
        }
    } finally {
        cleanupAfterCompletion(status);                  // ⑥ 清理 ThreadLocal
    }
}

回滚：completeTransactionAfterThrowing

Java
protected void completeTransactionAfterThrowing(@Nullable TransactionInfo txInfo, Throwable ex) {
    if (txInfo != null && txInfo.getTransactionStatus() != null) {
        if (txInfo.transactionAttribute != null && txInfo.transactionAttribute.rollbackOn(ex)) {
            try {
                txInfo.getTransactionManager().rollback(txInfo.getTransactionStatus());
            } catch (TransactionSystemException ex2) { ... }
        } else {
            // 不满足回滚规则 → 仍然提交（这就是受检异常默认不回滚的原因）
            try {
                txInfo.getTransactionManager().commit(txInfo.getTransactionStatus());
            } catch (TransactionSystemException ex2) { ... }
        }
    }
}

rollbackOn 的判定（DefaultTransactionAttribute）：

Java
public boolean rollbackOn(Throwable ex) {
    return (ex instanceof RuntimeException || ex instanceof Error);
}

RuleBasedTransactionAttribute 会先检查 rollbackFor / noRollbackFor 规则，再走默认逻辑。

事务同步器

Java
public interface TransactionSynchronization {
    int STATUS_COMMITTED = 0;
    int STATUS_ROLLED_BACK = 1;
    int STATUS_UNKNOWN = 2;

    default void suspend() { }
    default void resume() { }
    default void flush() { }
    default void beforeCommit(boolean readOnly) { }
    default void beforeCompletion() { }
    default void afterCommit() { }
    default void afterCompletion(int status) { }
}

注册方式：

Java
TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() {
    @Override
    public void afterCommit() { sendMessage(); }        // 事务提交后发消息
});

@TransactionalEventListener 就是基于这个机制实现的。

#6.6 事务失效：八个原因与源码位置

#现象源码原因解决
1同类方法自调用走 this，没进代理，TransactionInterceptor 不执行拆类 / 注入自身 / AopContext.currentProxy()
2非 public 方法Spring 文档明确只对 public 方法生效（JDK 代理只能代理接口 public 方法）改 public
3异常被 catch 吞掉completeTransactionAfterThrowing 没被触发重新抛出
4受检异常不回滚rollbackOn 只认 RuntimeException / Error@Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
5多线程ConnectionHolder 绑在 ThreadLocal，子线程拿不到拆事务 / 用编程式事务
6类未被 Spring 管理new 出来的对象没有代理交给容器
7数据库引擎不支持MyISAM 无事务换 InnoDB
8try-catch 后 return 了错误结果异常没传播手动 setRollbackOnly()

第 1 条的三种解法：

Java
// 解法一：注入自身
@Service
public class OrderService {
    @Autowired private OrderService self;

    public void a() { self.b(); }             // 走代理
    @Transactional public void b() { }
}

// 解法二：AopContext
@Service
@EnableAspectJAutoProxy(exposeProxy = true)
public class OrderService {
    public void a() {
        ((OrderService) AopContext.currentProxy()).b();
    }
    @Transactional public void b() { }
}

// 解法三：拆到另一个 Bean（最推荐）
@Service
public class OrderService {
    @Autowired private OrderTxService txService;
    public void a() { txService.b(); }
}

#6.7 多数据源与多事务管理器

Java
@Configuration
public class TxConfig {
    @Bean
    public PlatformTransactionManager orderTxManager(DataSource orderDs) {
        return new DataSourceTransactionManager(orderDs);
    }

    @Bean
    public PlatformTransactionManager userTxManager(DataSource userDs) {
        return new DataSourceTransactionManager(userDs);
    }
}

使用：

Java
@Transactional("orderTxManager")
public void createOrder() { }

determineTransactionManager 的查找顺序：

Text
① this.transactionManager（构造时注入的）
② 容器中唯一的 PlatformTransactionManager
③ 名为 "transactionManager" 的 Bean
④ 以上都不满足 → 抛 NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException

#6.8 事务与自定义 AOP 的顺序

因为有两个 BeanPostProcessor，一个 Bean 可能被代理多次：

Text
原始对象 → 事务代理（InfrastructureAdvisorAutoProxyCreator）
        → 自定义 AOP 代理（AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator）

如果两者都能匹配，执行顺序由 @Order 决定：

Java
@Aspect
@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)     // 比事务更外层
@Component
public class LogAspect { }

@Transactional 的 order 默认是 Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE，意味着自定义切面默认在事务外层（先执行自定义切面，再进入事务）。

#6.9 只读事务与超时

Java
@Transactional(readOnly = true, timeout = 5, isolation = Isolation.READ_COMMITTED)
  • readOnly = true：DataSourceTransactionManager 会调用 Connection.setReadOnly(true)，并传给数据库（MySQL 会开启只读优化，某些主从框架据此路由到从库）。
  • timeout：设置 ConnectionHolder.setTimeoutInSeconds，且 JdbcTemplate 会配合 Statement.setQueryTimeout。
  • isolation：DataSourceUtils.prepareConnectionForTransaction 设置并记录原值，事务结束后恢复。

#第 7 章　Spring MVC：一次请求的完整旅程

#7.1 架构总览

Spring MVC 是前端控制器模式（Front Controller）的经典实现：

Text
浏览器
  │  HTTP 请求
  ▼
Filter 链（CharacterEncodingFilter / CorsFilter ...）
  ▼
DispatcherServlet（前端控制器，唯一的入口）
  ├─ ① HandlerMapping      → 找到"谁来处理"（Controller 方法）
  ├─ ② HandlerAdapter      → 找到"怎么调用"（参数解析 + 反射 + 返回值处理）
  ├─ ③ HandlerInterceptor  → 前置/后置/完成回调
  ├─ ④ HandlerExceptionResolver → 异常兜底
  └─ ⑤ ViewResolver + View → 渲染响应
  ▼
HTTP 响应

九大组件（DispatcherServlet.initStrategies 初始化）：

#组件职责默认实现
1MultipartResolver文件上传解析StandardServletMultipartResolver
2LocaleResolver国际化区域AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver
3ThemeResolver主题FixedThemeResolver
4HandlerMapping请求 → 处理器RequestMappingHandlerMapping
5HandlerAdapter处理器 → 调用RequestMappingHandlerAdapter
6HandlerExceptionResolver异常 → 响应三个组合
7RequestToViewNameTranslator无视图名时的默认视图DefaultRequestToViewNameTranslator
8ViewResolver视图名 → ViewInternalResourceViewResolver
9FlashMapManager重定向传参SessionFlashMapManager

#7.2 启动初始化

7.2.1 继承链

Text
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
  ↑
HttpServletBean          ← 把 <init-param> 绑定到 Bean 属性（init() 里调用 initBeanWrapper）
  ↑
FrameworkServlet         ← 创建/获取 WebApplicationContext，重写 service() / doGet() / doPost()
  ↑
DispatcherServlet        ← 九大组件 + doDispatch

7.2.2 初始化流程

Java
// HttpServletBean
public final void init() throws ServletException {
    PropertyValues pvs = new ServletConfigPropertyValues(getServletConfig(), this.requiredProperties);
    BeanWrapper bw = PropertyAccessorFactory.forBeanPropertyAccess(this);
    ResourceLoader resourceLoader = new ServletContextResourceLoader(getServletContext());
    bw.registerCustomEditor(Resource.class, new ResourceEditor(resourceLoader, getEnvironment()));
    initBeanWrapper(bw);
    bw.setPropertyValues(pvs, true);
    initServletBean();                         // ← 模板方法
}

// FrameworkServlet
protected final void initServletBean() throws ServletException {
    this.webApplicationContext = initWebApplicationContext();
    initFrameworkServlet();                    // 空钩子
}

protected WebApplicationContext initWebApplicationContext() {
    // ① 查找根容器（ContextLoaderListener 创建的）
    WebApplicationContext rootContext = WebApplicationContextUtils.getWebApplicationContext(getServletContext());
    WebApplicationContext wac = null;

    // ② 如果构造时传了 context，用它
    if (this.webApplicationContext != null) {
        wac = this.webApplicationContext;
        if (wac instanceof ConfigurableWebApplicationContext cwac) {
            if (cwac.getParent() == null) cwac.setParent(rootContext);
            configureAndRefreshWebApplicationContext(cwac);
        }
    }
    // ③ 否则从 ServletContext 找
    if (wac == null) wac = findWebApplicationContext();
    // ④ 都没有 → 新建
    if (wac == null) wac = createWebApplicationContext(rootContext);

    if (!this.refreshEventReceived) {
        synchronized (this.onRefreshMonitor) {
            onRefresh(wac);                   // ← DispatcherServlet 重写：initStrategies
        }
    }
    return wac;
}

父子容器：

Text
Root WebApplicationContext（ContextLoaderListener 创建，装 Service / DAO）
  └── Child WebApplicationContext（DispatcherServlet 创建，装 Controller）

子容器可以访问父容器的 Bean，反之不行。这解释了为什么 Controller 能注入 Service，而 Service 注入不到 Controller。

7.2.3 initStrategies

Java
protected void initStrategies(ApplicationContext context) {
    initMultipartResolver(context);
    initLocaleResolver(context);
    initThemeResolver(context);
    initHandlerMappings(context);
    initHandlerAdapters(context);
    initHandlerExceptionResolvers(context);
    initRequestToViewNameTranslator(context);
    initViewResolvers(context);
    initFlashMapManager(context);
}

每个 initXxx 的套路都一样：

Java
private void initHandlerMappings(ApplicationContext context) {
    this.handlerMappings = null;
    if (this.detectAllHandlerMappings) {
        // 从容器找所有 HandlerMapping（含父容器）
        Map<String, HandlerMapping> matchingBeans = BeanFactoryUtils.beansOfTypeIncludingAncestors(
                context, HandlerMapping.class, true, false);
        if (!matchingBeans.isEmpty()) {
            this.handlerMappings = new ArrayList<>(matchingBeans.values());
            AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.sort(this.handlerMappings);       // 按 @Order 排序
        }
    } else {
        // 只找名为 handlerMapping 的
    }
    if (this.handlerMappings == null) {
        // 兜底：用 DispatcherServlet.properties 里的默认实现
        this.handlerMappings = getDefaultStrategies(context, HandlerMapping.class);
    }
}

兜底机制：如果容器里一个都没配，会读 DispatcherServlet.properties 加载默认实现。这也是"不写任何配置也能跑"的原因。

#7.3 doDispatch：九步源码

Java
protected void doDispatch(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws Exception {
    HttpServletRequest processedRequest = request;
    HandlerExecutionChain mappedHandler = null;
    boolean multipartRequestParsed = false;

    WebAsyncManager asyncManager = WebAsyncUtils.getAsyncManager(request);

    try {
        ModelAndView mv = null;
        Exception dispatchException = null;

        try {
            // ① 文件上传解析
            processedRequest = checkMultipart(request);
            multipartRequestParsed = (processedRequest != request);

            // ② 找 Handler（返回 HandlerExecutionChain：handler + 拦截器链）
            mappedHandler = getHandler(processedRequest);
            if (mappedHandler == null) {
                noHandlerFound(processedRequest, response);
                return;
            }

            // ③ 找 HandlerAdapter
            HandlerAdapter ha = getHandlerAdapter(mappedHandler.getHandler());

            // ④ 处理 Last-Modified（GET/HEAD 的缓存）
            String method = request.getMethod();
            boolean isGet = HttpMethod.GET.matches(method);
            if (isGet || HttpMethod.HEAD.matches(method)) {
                long lastModified = ha.getLastModified(request, mappedHandler.getHandler());
                if (new ServletWebRequest(request, response).checkNotModified(lastModified) && isGet) {
                    return;
                }
            }

            // ⑤ 前置拦截
            if (!mappedHandler.applyPreHandle(processedRequest, response)) {
                return;
            }

            // ⑥ 真正执行：参数解析 + 反射调用 + 返回值处理
            mv = ha.handle(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler.getHandler());

            if (asyncManager.isConcurrentHandlingStarted()) {
                return;
            }

            // ⑦ 默认视图名
            applyDefaultViewName(processedRequest, mv);

            // ⑧ 后置拦截
            mappedHandler.applyPostHandle(processedRequest, response, mv);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            dispatchException = ex;
        } catch (Throwable err) {
            dispatchException = new NestedServletException("Handler dispatch failed", err);
        }

        // ⑨ 处理结果：异常解析 + 视图渲染 + 完成后置
        processDispatchResult(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler, mv, dispatchException);
    } catch (Exception ex) {
        triggerAfterCompletion(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler, ex);
    } catch (Throwable err) {
        triggerAfterCompletion(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler, new NestedServletException(...));
    } finally {
        if (multipartRequestParsed) cleanupMultipart(processedRequest);
    }
}

getHandler

Java
protected HandlerExecutionChain getHandler(HttpServletRequest request) throws Exception {
    if (this.handlerMappings != null) {
        for (HandlerMapping mapping : this.handlerMappings) {
            HandlerExecutionChain handler = mapping.getHandler(request);
            if (handler != null) return handler;      // 第一个返回非 null 的胜出
        }
    }
    return null;
}

getHandlerAdapter

Java
protected HandlerAdapter getHandlerAdapter(Object handler) throws ServletException {
    if (this.handlerAdapters != null) {
        for (HandlerAdapter adapter : this.handlerAdapters) {
            if (adapter.supports(handler)) return adapter;
        }
    }
    throw new ServletException("No adapter for handler [" + handler + "]");
}

为什么需要 Adapter？ 因为 Handler 的类型可能多种多样（@Controller 方法、HttpRequestHandler、Servlet、RouterFunction）。Adapter 让 DispatcherServlet 不必关心具体类型——这是适配器模式的典型应用。

processDispatchResult

Java
private void processDispatchResult(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,
        @Nullable HandlerExecutionChain mappedHandler, @Nullable ModelAndView mv,
        @Nullable Exception exception) throws Exception {

    boolean errorView = false;

    // ① 异常解析
    if (exception != null) {
        if (exception instanceof ModelAndViewDefiningException mavDefiningException) {
            mv = mavDefiningException.getModelAndView();
        } else {
            Object handler = (mappedHandler != null ? mappedHandler.getHandler() : null);
            mv = processHandlerException(request, response, handler, exception);
            errorView = (mv != null);
        }
    }

    // ② 渲染
    if (mv != null && !mv.wasCleared()) {
        render(mv, request, response);
        if (errorView) WebUtils.clearErrorRequestAttributes(request);
    } else {
        if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) logger.trace("No view rendering, null ModelAndView returned.");
    }

    if (WebAsyncUtils.getAsyncManager(request).isConcurrentHandlingStarted()) {
        return;
    }

    // ③ 完成后置
    if (mappedHandler != null) {
        mappedHandler.triggerAfterCompletion(request, response, null);
    }
}

#7.4 HandlerMapping：请求怎么找到 Controller

7.4.1 初始化：扫描所有 @Controller

Java
// AbstractHandlerMethodMapping.afterPropertiesSet
public void afterPropertiesSet() {
    initHandlerMethods();
}

protected void initHandlerMethods() {
    // ① 拿到所有候选 Bean 名
    for (String beanName : getCandidateBeanNames()) {
        if (!beanName.startsWith(SCOPED_TARGET_NAME_PREFIX)) {
            processCandidateBean(beanName);
        }
    }
    handlerMethodsInitialized(getHandlerMethods());
}

protected void processCandidateBean(String beanName) {
    Class<?> beanType = null;
    try {
        beanType = obtainApplicationContext().getType(beanName);
    } catch (Throwable ex) { }
    // ② 判定是不是 Handler
    if (beanType != null && isHandler(beanType)) {
        detectHandlerMethods(beanName);
    }
}

// RequestMappingHandlerMapping
protected boolean isHandler(Class<?> beanType) {
    return (AnnotatedElementUtils.hasAnnotation(beanType, Controller.class) ||
            AnnotatedElementUtils.hasAnnotation(beanType, RequestMapping.class));
}

detectHandlerMethods 解析每个方法：

Java
protected void detectHandlerMethods(Object handler) {
    Class<?> handlerType = (handler instanceof String beanName ?
            obtainApplicationContext().getType(beanName) : handler.getClass());

    if (handlerType != null) {
        Class<?> userType = ClassUtils.getUserClass(handlerType);
        Map<Method, T> methods = MethodIntrospector.selectMethods(userType,
                (MethodIntrospector.MetadataLookup<T>) method -> {
                    try {
                        return getMappingForMethod(method, userType);    // 解析 @RequestMapping
                    } catch (Throwable ex) { ... }
                });
        methods.forEach((method, mapping) -> {
            Method invocableMethod = AopUtils.selectInvocableMethod(method, userType);
            registerHandlerMethod(handler, invocableMethod, mapping);
        });
    }
}

getMappingForMethod 会把类上的 @RequestMapping 与方法上的合并：

Java
protected RequestMappingInfo getMappingForMethod(Method method, Class<?> handlerType) {
    RequestMappingInfo info = createRequestMappingInfo(method);
    if (info != null) {
        RequestMappingInfo typeInfo = createRequestMappingInfo(handlerType);
        if (typeInfo != null) {
            info = typeInfo.combine(info);       // 类路径 + 方法路径
        }
        // 处理 @RequestMapping 的 name / required / 版本条件
    }
    return info;
}

7.4.2 RequestMappingInfo：一个请求的"指纹"

Java
public final class RequestMappingInfo implements RequestCondition<RequestMappingInfo> {
    private final PatternsRequestCondition patternsCondition;      // 路径
    private final RequestMethodsRequestCondition methodsCondition; // HTTP 方法
    private final RequestParamsRequestCondition paramsCondition;   // 参数
    private final RequestHeadersRequestCondition headersCondition; // 请求头
    private final ConsumesRequestCondition consumesCondition;      // Content-Type
    private final ProducesRequestCondition producesCondition;      // Accept
    private final RequestConditionHolder customConditionHolder;    // 自定义条件
}

注册结构（MappingRegistry）：

Java
class MappingRegistry {
    private final Map<T, MappingRegistration<T>> registry = new HashMap<>();          // 全部映射
    private final Map<T, HandlerMethod> mappingLookup = new LinkedHashMap<>();        // 映射 → 方法
    private final MultiValueMap<String, T> urlLookup = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();   // 路径 → 映射
    private final Map<String, List<HandlerMethod>> nameLookup = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<HandlerMethod, CorsConfiguration> corsLookup = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
}

7.4.3 匹配过程：lookupHandlerMethod

Java
protected HandlerMethod lookupHandlerMethod(String lookupPath, HttpServletRequest request) throws Exception {
    List<Match> matches = new ArrayList<>();

    // ① 直接路径匹配（urlLookup，命中率最高）
    List<T> directPathMatches = this.mappingRegistry.getMappingsByDirectPath(lookupPath);
    if (directPathMatches != null) {
        addMatchingMappings(directPathMatches, matches, request);
    }

    // ② 没有直接命中 → 遍历所有映射，做条件匹配（含通配符）
    if (matches.isEmpty()) {
        addMatchingMappings(this.mappingRegistry.getRegistrations().keySet(), matches, request);
    }

    if (!matches.isEmpty()) {
        // ③ 排序：最具体的优先
        Match bestMatch = matches.get(0);
        if (matches.size() > 1) {
            Comparator<Match> comparator = new MatchComparator(getMappingComparator(request));
            matches.sort(comparator);
            bestMatch = matches.get(0);
            if (logger.isTraceEnabled()) { ... }
            // ④ 如果有两个"并列最佳" → 抛异常（模糊映射）
            if (comparator.compare(bestMatch, matches.get(1)) == 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Ambiguous handler methods mapped for '" + lookupPath + "': {" +
                        bestMatch.handlerMethod + ", " + matches.get(1).handlerMethod + "}");
            }
        }
        handleMatch(bestMatch.mapping, lookupPath, request);
        return bestMatch.handlerMethod;
    } else {
        return handleNoMatch(this.mappingRegistry.getRegistrations().keySet(), lookupPath, request);
    }
}

addMatchingMappings 内部调用 mapping.getMatchingCondition(request)：

Java
public RequestMappingInfo getMatchingCondition(HttpServletRequest request) {
    RequestMethodsRequestCondition methods = this.methodsCondition.getMatchingCondition(request);
    if (methods == null) return null;
    ParamsRequestCondition params = this.paramsCondition.getMatchingCondition(request);
    if (params == null) return null;
    HeadersRequestCondition headers = this.headersCondition.getMatchingCondition(request);
    if (headers == null) return null;
    ConsumesRequestCondition consumes = this.consumesCondition.getMatchingCondition(request);
    if (consumes == null) return null;
    ProducesRequestCondition produces = this.producesCondition.getMatchingCondition(request);
    if (produces == null) return null;
    PatternsRequestCondition patterns = this.patternsCondition.getMatchingCondition(request);
    if (patterns == null) return null;
    // ... 返回合并后的新 RequestMappingInfo
}

路径匹配的演进：

版本匹配器说明
Spring 5.3 之前AntPathMatcher*、**、?
Spring 5.3+PathPattern更快的预解析实现，默认开启
Spring 6默认 PathPatternParser性能提升 3–6 倍

#7.5 HandlerAdapter：参数解析与反射调用

RequestMappingHandlerAdapter 是 MVC 最复杂的类，核心是四件套：

Java
public class RequestMappingHandlerAdapter extends AbstractHandlerMethodAdapter
        implements BeanFactoryAware, InitializingBean {

    private HandlerMethodArgumentResolverComposite argumentResolvers;              // 参数解析
    private HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlerComposite returnValueHandlers;          // 返回值处理
    private WebDataBinderFactory webBindingInitializer;                            // 数据绑定
    private ConversionService conversionService;                                   // 类型转换
}

7.5.1 初始化：注册 30+ 个解析器

Java
@Override
public void afterPropertiesSet() {
    // ① 初始化 @ControllerAdvice
    initControllerAdviceCache();

    // ② 参数解析器
    if (this.argumentResolvers == null) {
        List<HandlerMethodArgumentResolver> resolvers = getDefaultArgumentResolvers();
        this.argumentResolvers = new HandlerMethodArgumentResolverComposite().addResolvers(resolvers);
    }
    // ③ @InitBinder 的参数解析器
    if (this.initBinderArgumentResolvers == null) {
        List<HandlerMethodArgumentResolver> resolvers = getDefaultInitBinderArgumentResolvers();
        this.initBinderArgumentResolvers = new HandlerMethodArgumentResolverComposite().addResolvers(resolvers);
    }
    // ④ 返回值处理器
    if (this.returnValueHandlers == null) {
        List<HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler> handlers = getDefaultReturnValueHandlers();
        this.returnValueHandlers = new HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlerComposite().addHandlers(handlers);
    }
}

getDefaultArgumentResolvers 的顺序极其重要（靠前优先）：

Java
private List<HandlerMethodArgumentResolver> getDefaultArgumentResolvers() {
    List<HandlerMethodArgumentResolver> resolvers = new ArrayList<>(30);

    // ===== 注解驱动 =====
    resolvers.add(new RequestParamMethodArgumentResolver(getBeanFactory(), false));   // @RequestParam
    resolvers.add(new RequestParamMapMethodArgumentResolver());                       // @RequestParam Map
    resolvers.add(new PathVariableMethodArgumentResolver());                          // @PathVariable
    resolvers.add(new PathVariableMapMethodArgumentResolver());
    resolvers.add(new MatrixVariableMethodArgumentResolver());                        // @MatrixVariable
    resolvers.add(new RequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor(getMessageConverters(), ...)); // @RequestBody
    resolvers.add(new RequestPartMethodArgumentResolver(getMessageConverters(), ...)); // @RequestPart
    resolvers.add(new RequestHeaderMethodArgumentResolver(getBeanFactory()));         // @RequestHeader
    resolvers.add(new RequestHeaderMapMethodArgumentResolver());
    resolvers.add(new ServletCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver(getBeanFactory()));    // @CookieValue
    resolvers.add(new ExpressionValueMethodArgumentResolver(getBeanFactory()));       // @Value
    resolvers.add(new SessionAttributeMethodArgumentResolver());                      // @SessionAttribute
    resolvers.add(new RequestAttributeMethodArgumentResolver());                      // @RequestAttribute

    // ===== 类型驱动 =====
    resolvers.add(new ServletRequestMethodArgumentResolver());     // HttpServletRequest / Session / Principal / Locale
    resolvers.add(new ServletResponseMethodArgumentResolver());    // HttpServletResponse / OutputStream
    resolvers.add(new HttpEntityMethodProcessor(...));             // HttpEntity
    resolvers.add(new RedirectAttributesMethodArgumentResolver());
    resolvers.add(new ModelMethodArgumentResolver());              // Model

    // ===== 自定义 =====
    if (getCustomArgumentResolvers() != null) resolvers.addAll(getCustomArgumentResolvers());

    // ===== 兜底（必须最后） =====
    resolvers.add(new RequestParamMethodArgumentResolver(getBeanFactory(), true));    // 简单类型兜底
    resolvers.add(new ServletModelAttributeMethodProcessor(true));                    // @ModelAttribute 兜底

    return resolvers;
}

两个兜底解析器放在最后，这是设计上的"default 分支"：

  • RequestParamMethodArgumentResolver(useDefaultResolution=true)：没有注解的简单类型参数，当作 @RequestParam。
  • ServletModelAttributeMethodProcessor(annotationNotRequired=true)：没有注解的复杂对象，当作 @ModelAttribute 做数据绑定。

7.5.2 调用：invokeAndHandle

Java
// ServletInvocableHandlerMethod
public void invokeAndHandle(ServletWebRequest webRequest, ModelAndViewContainer mavContainer,
        Object... providedArgs) throws Exception {

    // ① 解析参数 + 反射调用
    Object returnValue = invokeForRequest(webRequest, mavContainer, providedArgs);

    // ② 设置响应状态（@ResponseStatus）
    setResponseStatus(webRequest);

    // ③ 返回值为空
    if (returnValue == null) {
        if (isRequestNotModified(webRequest) || getResponseStatus() != null || mavContainer.isRequestHandled()) {
            disableContentCachingIfNecessary(webRequest);
            mavContainer.setRequestHandled(true);
            return;
        }
    } else if (StringUtils.hasText(getResponseStatusReason())) {
        mavContainer.setRequestHandled(true);
        return;
    }

    mavContainer.setRequestHandled(false);
    try {
        // ④ 返回值处理
        this.returnValueHandlers.handleReturnValue(
                returnValue, getReturnValueType(returnValue), mavContainer, webRequest);
    } catch (Exception ex) { ... }
}

参数解析：

Java
// InvocableHandlerMethod
protected Object[] getMethodArgumentValues(NativeWebRequest request, @Nullable ModelAndViewContainer mavContainer,
        Object... providedArgs) throws Exception {

    MethodParameter[] parameters = getMethodParameters();
    if (ObjectUtils.isEmpty(parameters)) return EMPTY_ARGS;

    Object[] args = new Object[parameters.length];
    for (int i = 0; i < parameters.length; i++) {
        MethodParameter parameter = parameters[i];
        parameter.initParameterNameDiscovery(this.parameterNameDiscoverer);
        args[i] = findProvidedArgument(parameter, providedArgs);
        if (args[i] != null) continue;

        // ① 找解析器
        if (!this.resolvers.supportsParameter(parameter)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(formatArgumentError(parameter, "No suitable resolver"));
        }
        try {
            // ② 解析
            args[i] = this.resolvers.resolveArgument(parameter, mavContainer, request, this.dataBinderFactory);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            // ③ 异常信息增强（定位是哪个参数）
            throw new ServletException(formatArgumentError(parameter, ex.getMessage()), ex);
        }
    }
    return args;
}

7.5.3 @RequestBody 的解析过程

Java
// AbstractMessageConverterMethodArgumentResolver.readWithMessageConverters
protected <T> Object readWithMessageConverters(HttpInputMessage inputMessage, MethodParameter parameter,
        Type targetType) throws IOException, HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException, HttpMessageNotReadableException {

    MediaType contentType = inputMessage.getHeaders().getContentType();
    if (contentType == null) contentType = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM;

    Class<?> contextClass = parameter.getContainingClass();
    Class<T> targetClass = (targetType instanceof Class clazz ? clazz : null);

    // ① 遍历所有 HttpMessageConverter
    for (HttpMessageConverter<?> converter : this.messageConverters) {
        GenericHttpMessageConverter genericConverter =
                (converter instanceof GenericHttpMessageConverter ghmc ? ghmc : null);
        // ② 判断能否读
        if (genericConverter != null) {
            if (!genericConverter.canRead(targetType, contextClass, contentType)) continue;
        } else {
            if (!converter.canRead(targetClass, contentType)) continue;
        }
        // ③ 读
        if (message.hasBody()) {
            HttpMessageConverter<?> converterToUse = converter;
            ...
            Object body = genericConverter != null ?
                    genericConverter.read(targetType, contextClass, inputMessage) :
                    converter.read(targetClass, inputMessage);
            return body;
        }
    }
    throw new HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException(contentType, ...);
}

ResourceHttpMessageConverter文件下载

Java
private List<HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler> getDefaultReturnValueHandlers() {
    List<HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler> handlers = new ArrayList<>(20);

    // ===== 单值 =====
    handlers.add(new ModelAndViewMethodReturnValueHandler());

    handlers.add(new HttpHeadersReturnValueHandler());
    handlers.add(new CallableMethodReturnValueHandler());
    handlers.add(new DeferredResultMethodReturnValueHandler());
    handlers.add(new AsyncTaskMethodReturnValueHandler(this.beanFactory));

    // ===== 注解 =====
    handlers.add(new ServletModelAttributeMethodProcessor(false));   // @ModelAttribute
    handlers.add(new RequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor(getMessageConverters(), ...));  // @ResponseBody

    // ===== 多值 =====

    handlers.add(new MapMethodReturnValueHandler());

    // ===== 自定义 =====
    if (getCustomReturnValueHandlers() != null) handlers.addAll(getCustomReturnValueHandlers());

    // ===== 兜底 =====
    if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(getModelAndViewResolvers())) { ... }
    else {
        handlers.add(new ModelAndViewResolverMethodReturnValueHandler(...));
    }
    return handlers;
}

#7.7 异常处理

7.7.1 三类解析器

Text
HandlerExceptionResolverComposite
  ├── ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver      ← @ExceptionHandler / @ControllerAdvice
  ├── ResponseStatusExceptionResolver        ← @ResponseStatus
  └── DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver        ← 标准 Spring 异常 → HTTP 状态码

7.7.2 processHandlerException

Java
protected ModelAndView processHandlerException(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,
        @Nullable Object handler, Exception ex) throws Exception {

    // ① 清理可能残留的媒体类型属性
    request.removeAttribute(HandlerMapping.PRODUCIBLE_MEDIA_TYPES_ATTRIBUTE);

    ModelAndView exMv = null;
    if (this.handlerExceptionResolvers != null) {
        // ② 依次尝试
        for (HandlerExceptionResolver resolver : this.handlerExceptionResolvers) {
            exMv = resolver.resolveException(request, response, handler, ex);
            if (exMv != null) break;
        }
    }
    if (exMv != null) {
        if (exMv.isEmpty()) {
            request.setAttribute(EXCEPTION_ATTRIBUTE, ex);
            return null;
        }
        // ③ 合并 Model
        if (!exMv.hasView()) {
            String defaultViewName = getDefaultViewName(request);
            if (defaultViewName != null) exMv.setViewName(defaultViewName);
        }
        // ④ 暴露异常信息到 request
        WebUtils.exposeErrorRequestAttributes(request, ex, getServletName());
        return exMv;
    }

    throw ex;       // ⑤ 都不处理 → 抛给容器（Tomcat 错误页）
}

7.7.3 @ExceptionHandler 的查找

Java
// ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver.doResolveHandlerMethodException
protected ModelAndView doResolveHandlerMethodException(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,
        @Nullable HandlerMethod handlerMethod, Exception exception) {

    // ① 找处理方法：先找 Controller 内的 @ExceptionHandler，再找 @ControllerAdvice
    ServletInvocableHandlerMethod exceptionHandlerMethod = getExceptionHandlerMethod(handlerMethod, exception);
    if (exceptionHandlerMethod == null) return null;

    // ② 设置参数解析器（与普通方法一致）
    if (this.argumentResolvers != null) exceptionHandlerMethod.setHandlerMethodArgumentResolvers(this.argumentResolvers);
    if (this.returnValueHandlers != null) exceptionHandlerMethod.setHandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers(this.returnValueHandlers);

    ServletWebRequest webRequest = new ServletWebRequest(request, response);
    ModelAndViewContainer mavContainer = new ModelAndViewContainer();

    try {
        exceptionHandlerMethod.invokeAndHandle(webRequest, mavContainer, exception, handlerMethod);
    } catch (Throwable invocationEx) {
        return null;
    }

    if (mavContainer.isRequestHandled()) {
        return new ModelAndView();
    }
    ModelMap model = mavContainer.getModel();
    ModelAndView mav = new ModelAndView();
    mav.setStatus(mavContainer.getStatus());
    mav.setViewName(mavContainer.getViewName());
    mav.addAllObjects(model);
    return mav;
}

匹配优先级：ExceptionDepthComparator 按异常的继承层级排序，越具体越优先。

Java
@ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)   // 更具体 → 优先
public ResponseEntity<?> handleIllegalArg(IllegalArgumentException e) { ... }

@ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)                  // 兜底
public ResponseEntity<?> handleAll(Exception e) { ... }

#7.8 视图渲染

Java
protected void render(ModelAndView mv, HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws Exception {
    // ① 确定 Locale
    Locale locale = (this.localeResolver != null ? this.localeResolver.resolveLocale(request) : request.getLocale());
    response.setLocale(locale);

    View view;
    String viewName = mv.getViewName();
    if (viewName != null) {
        // ② 视图名 → View
        view = resolveViewName(viewName, mv.getModelInternal(), locale, request);
        if (view == null) throw new ServletException("Could not resolve view with name '" + viewName + "'...");
    } else {
        view = mv.getView();
        if (view == null) throw new ServletException("ModelAndView [" + mv + "] neither contains a view name nor a View object");
    }

    // ③ 渲染
    if (mv.getStatus() != null) response.setStatus(mv.getStatus().value());
    view.render(mv.getModelInternal(), request, response);
}

Java
@Bean
public ViewResolver viewResolver() {
    InternalResourceViewResolver resolver = new InternalResourceViewResolver();
    resolver.setPrefix("/WEB-INF/views/");

    resolver.setOrder(1);
